header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This Petition was filed in year 2021. Even on 28-02-2025 when none was present on behalf of the petitioner, it was observed that petition is liable to be dismissed for nonprosecution; however, in the interest of justice matter is adjourned. Today none has appeared on behalf of petitioner, which reflects that petitioner and his counsel have lost interest to pursue instant petition, therefore, same stands dismissed for non-prosecution.
